Mature T-cell leukemia within the non-Hodgkin lymphoma spectrum; blood and marrow disease with an applicable lymphoma mechanism axis.
Benign neoplasm of capillary blood vessels; the umbrella includes tumors at multiple anatomical sites.

Brucella suis infection; osteoarticular infection occurs in roughly 30-50% of brucellosis cases, with estimates varying by series.
Mediastinal soft connective tissue lies outside the specified axes; this definition establishes no lung, airway, cardiac or locomotor tissue origin.
Isolated spermatogenic failure causes reproductive infertility without established endocrine dysfunction or another covered organ disorder.

Immune-mediated oligoarthritis; associated uveitis is a separately diagnosed disease and its frequency varies around or below 30%.

Gestational trophoblastic malignancy originates in reproductive tissue; no covered organ involvement is established.
Cancer originates in the frontal paranasal sinus, included in the airway axis.
Progressive corticospinal disease; HPO places structural scoliosis and pes cavus in 30-79%, despite the definition describing them as less common.
Retinal cone degeneration with visual field loss and optic atrophy; the optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis.
Immune-mediated pustular inflammation of skin; additional organ damage is not established across the umbrella.
Disordered vitamin D metabolism and hypocalcemia cause defective skeletal mineralization; both metabolic and bone disease define the group.
Inflammation of the tympanic membrane; the umbrella does not establish an infectious or autoimmune cause in every form.
